project: ResolveX — Agentic AI IT Support Ticket Resolution Platform

summary.description: ResolveX is an agentic AI platform designed for autonomous IT support ticket diagnosis, retrieval-augmented resolution, safety verification, and human-in-the-loop (HITL) routing.
summary.architecture_summary: 12-node LangGraph orchestration workflow backed by FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Hybrid BM25 + FAISS Dense retrieval, Cross-Encoder reranking, Contextual Bandit Policy layer, and Deterministic Safety Guards.

performance_metrics.primary_bottleneck: External LLM API inference latency (90.86% of total workflow duration)

prompt_optimization.latency_impact_note: Prompt token payload was reduced by 34.92%, but end-to-end latency improvement was not demonstrated due to external API latency variance.

safety_and_security.fail_closed_behavior: Enforced (all errors/failures default to human_review or ask_clarification)

ci_cd_and_deployment.deployment_type: Production-style single-node deployment (FastAPI uvicorn + local PostgreSQL)

limitations: External LLM API dependency induces non-deterministic inference latency
Single-node deployment lacks multi-region failover and horizontal auto-scaling
Contextual bandit policy training requires offline replay updates
